lede: The most consequential meeting this week is the Gondola Leadership Committee on July 28, where the agenda flags capital investment funding commitments and what looks like a real action item on the gondola's future — worth paying attention to. Town Council also convenes July 27 as the Liquor Licensing Authority for a public hearing on KOTO Radio's Live at the Drive permit at 207 N Pine. Around all that, the week fills out with Shakespeare in the Park, Box Canyon Races, and a climate and energy Town Talk on Tuesday.
